summary: Iteration 136 — Salary slip rule fixes verified. Backend pytest 7/7 pass (staff list, Priya PDF slip for 2026-08 contains 'Service commission (10.0%)' with amount = 10% of Service gross, contains 'Gross earnings' and 'Net payable', does NOT contain 'withheld'; overtime line hidden when overtime_rate=0; unknown sid -> 404; invalid month 'abc' -> 400; staff portal /api/staff/me/salary-slip JSON: commission_amount == service_gross*pct/100, commission_withheld=false, overtime_total=0 when overtime_rate=0, net_payable matches formula ±0.01; attendance/today 200; PUT /api/staff/{sid} idempotent PUT returns 200 with X-Owner-Pin+CSRF). Frontend: /staff loads 6 staff cards; salary-slip-month-<id> select renders with 12 monthly options (Sept 2026 down to Oct 2025); salary-slip-<id> button next to it; Priya card correctly wired (id 3cdf66d1-...). Selecting 'Aug 2026' + clicking Slip opened a popup via window.open (context.expect_page fired). Edit modal for Priya shows Overtime ₹/hr field with the exact hint 'Leave 0 = no overtime is paid; late fines still apply.' below it (verified in code + rendered). Managers (Rahul) correctly do NOT get the Slip UI (isManager check hides it) — 4 slip buttons for 6 cards is expected. Note: Priya has overtime_rate=100/hr so overtime WILL show for her; the overtime-hidden rule is exercised via unit assertion (pdf text) on staff whose overtime_rate==0.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF _render_salary_slip_pdf still keeps the legacy 'withheld' branch (line ~562) even though _compute_salary_for_month now always sets commission_withheld=False. Harmless but dead code — consider removing to avoid future regressions if someone re-introduces withholding.
_render_salary_slip_pdf 'Overtime' line only renders when overtime_total>0; this correctly hides both label and value when overtime_rate==0. Matches spec.

Frontend StaffCard uses window.open with API URL directly — relies on the JWT cookie being sent cross-tab. Works because API is same origin. If a user disables 3rd-party cookies this could break; consider a signed one-shot download token in future.
salary-slip-month select generates 12 months by decrementing month(-i); on year boundary this correctly rolls back (Date.setMonth handles it). Confirmed Sept 2026 → Oct 2025 range in UI.

Manager check in StaffCard (`isManager`) hides the Slip UI entirely — good; managers currently cannot download their own or others' slips from this card. If owner needs to download a manager's slip, they'd need a separate path.
